video_title: We get HEATED that Jalen Brunson is AHEAD of Shai Gilgeous-Alexander 👀

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson argues Jalen Brunson surpassed Luka Doncic this season
quotes.excerpt: I'd say Jalen surpassed Luka. Luka you with me?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: I'd say Jalen surpassed Luka. Luka you with me?

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: You trying to kill me for that. He wasn't with me. It was him.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on Jalen Brunson's elite playoff efficiency
quotes.excerpt: I'm talking 30 a game efficiently. Nobody else on the team act like they can bounce the ball.
quotes.quote: I'm talking 30 a game efficiently. Nobody else on the team act like they can bounce the ball when it matters. I'm talking about when it's time to create, Jalen isn't going to score 100. It's a team game, you got to do something. Jalen isn't going to score 100, but every year before that he was one of the best players in the playoffs.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson claims Jalen Brunson's supporting cast outperformed Luka Doncic's
quotes.excerpt: Luka's never had a player that come to the party like Jalen Brunson did this year.
quotes.quote: Luka's never had a player that come to the party like Jalen Brunson did this year. Never. There's never been a mention that Jalen Brunson has been on the same level as Luka until he won a championship. But Luka's never had a player that come to the party like Jalen Brunson did this year.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson defends Dirk Nowitzki's 2011 championship run
quotes.excerpt: I think Dirk Nowitzki had the best playoff run. Because he won a championship.
quotes.quote: I think Dirk Nowitzki had the best playoff run. Because he won a championship. Did his teammates show up more than Jalen Brunson's teammates? They showed up equal amount. Jason Terry wasn't fucking trying.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson argues team success is the ultimate factor in player evaluation
quotes.excerpt: This is a team game. I don't give a fuck if Michael Jordan was on that team.
quotes.quote: This is a team game. I don't give a fuck if Michael Jordan was on that team. He wasn't beating that Warriors team. This is a team game. I don't give a fuck if Michael Jordan was on that damn Cleveland team. He wasn't beating that Warriors team.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on the roster limitations of the 2011 Mavericks
quotes.excerpt: We had the problem they had before they won a championship. We couldn't play our bench.
quotes.quote: We had the problem they had before they won a championship. We couldn't play our bench. No disrespect to my guys, but Reggie Bullock and Dorian Finney-Smith had to play 43, 44 minutes a game. They were cooked and then our final, our last playoff series, we had to guard Steph Curry and Klay Thompson. They were cooked, bro. They were fried and we ran out of fucking gas.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson criticizes Jalen Brunson's turnover issues
quotes.excerpt: When Jalen Brunson turns the ball over because he do, he fucks up.
quotes.quote: When Jalen Brunson turns the ball over because he do, he fucks up or he gets fouled or whatever, he's running back with his teammates. I'm not complaining with the referees. That will fuck up chemistry. Get your fucking ass back on defense. We trying to win this goddamn game.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson ranks his top five NBA players
quotes.excerpt: My three probably has to be Wembanyama, Luka, Giannis. I go Luka, then Giannis.
quotes.quote: My three probably has to be Wembanyama, Luka, Giannis. I go Luka, then Giannis. I looked at Giannis' numbers last night. This nigga is a fucking issue. Number five for me is Kawhi. Actually, I put Kawhi over Giannis to be honest with you. Kawhi top five for me. That's been a unanimous for me. I've said this. I go Wembanyama, Luka, Giannis. I go Kawhi, then I go KD, Steph, Brunson.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on Kawhi Leonard's efficiency
quotes.excerpt: You know that Kawhi was the most efficient player in the fourth.
quotes.quote: You know that Kawhi was the most efficient player in the fourth. He might not have the most points because the motherfucker didn't have to play in the fourth. There's a difference. So if you don't have to play, you can't get the most points if you don't have to play.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on Kawhi Leonard's scoring mentality
quotes.excerpt: When Kawhi has the ball, he's going to score.
quotes.quote: When Kawhi has the ball, he's going to score. So like I think he takes advantage of his opportunity every single time he has the ball. So I think both things, does he draw charges? Does he draw charges? That's a form of defense. That's like getting a steal.
